hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic/logical unification over specialized engines reduces boundary/reconstruction overhead without requiring a physical monolith.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Planner/receipt overhead erases the saved boundary cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target FRANK p95/p99 and CPU cost are not better than existing specialized path at equal correctness.
hypotheses.next_test: live twin A/B with identical queries and route receipts

hypotheses.hypothesis: One authoritative event/state spine plus durable derivation log provides sufficient cognitive consistency for graph/vector/FTS/activation sidecars while preserving replay.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Derived lag causes unacceptable cognition errors even when explicit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fault-injection or live shadow shows derived lag causes effect-critical wrong decisions despite exact-anchor validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Operation-specific consistency witnesses outperform a global all-store barrier because unrelated store churn is not causally relevant.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Dependency declaration misses hidden cross-store dependencies and admits unsafe effects.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fuzzing finds effect-relevant dependency changes omitted by capsule compiler.
hypotheses.next_test: stateful property fuzzing over queries, aliases, dynamic targets and negative predicates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Query-plan/candidate-set identity is required for reproducible cognition whenever ranked retrieval determines Assembly membership.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Record provenance plus deterministic planner version is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Selection attacks cannot change outcome when plan/candidate receipts are omitted under controlled mutations.
hypotheses.next_test: plan mutation + candidate omission/redirection attack on twin tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Background ClayGraph/activation updates between LLM calls improve long-horizon agent recall and continuity versus explicit retrieval-only memory at lower token cost.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Automatic activation mainly adds false associations and stale anchoring.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched long-horizon tasks show no quality/token advantage or worse false-memory rate.
hypotheses.next_test: three-arm no-memory vs explicit-search vs state-continuity activation on target 4B

hypotheses.hypothesis: A bounded Assembly-ready frontier lets a 4B use a much larger latent memory substrate without context-window growth proportional to stored memory.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Useful multi-hop information still requires near-linear prompt/context expansion.
hypotheses.falsifier: Task accuracy collapses as latent store grows unless prompt tokens scale similarly.
hypotheses.next_test: memory-size scaling curve at fixed Assembly token budgets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vector and FTS stores should remain derived sidecars because approximation/model-version churn outweighs benefits of making them canonical.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Integrated canonical vector/text storage materially improves correctness/latency/recovery.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target benchmark shows integrated authoritative vector/FTS path dominates on Pareto frontier without semantic/version risks.
hypotheses.next_test: pgvector/Postgres vs external ANN/FTS vs embedded consolidated candidate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Capabilities/secrets must stay physically isolated even in a unified Clay semantic world.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Typed rows inside the unified database provide equivalent containment.
hypotheses.falsifier: Adversarial capability tests show unified-store design has equal/better least-privilege, revocation and blast-radius properties.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physical colocation should be adaptive/per-subplan because read, write, concurrency and recovery regimes have different winners.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One target engine dominates after engineering optimization.
hypotheses.falsifier: Representative live workload shows one placement strictly dominates specialized/hybrid alternatives across correctness, p99, write amplification and recovery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Zero-copy/shared-memory lowering can capture most transport benefit without collapsing semantic store boundaries.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Ownership/version synchronization costs dominate and erase zero-copy gains.
hypotheses.falsifier: Arrow/shared-memory prototype has no p99/CPU/energy advantage at equal safety.
hypotheses.next_test: Rust/Arrow shared-memory subplan benchmark on Linux and Android

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cognitive State Continuity increases functional self-continuity when SELF/goals/consequences are canonical graph relations and activation can persist across calls.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Observed continuity is explainable by ordinary retrieval/summarization with no substrate-specific advantage.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched retrieval baseline equals continuity, causal self-reference and intervention sensitivity at equal token/latency budget.
hypotheses.next_test: lesion/rescue of self-state activation with retrieval-matched control

hypotheses.hypothesis: UnifiedDB can provide a manipulable substrate for functional consciousness-theory components such as persistent self-model, associative memory, attention and re-entry.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Those components can be implemented equally without unified substrate and no causal advantage results.
hypotheses.falsifier: Stage-orthogonal experiments show no integration/re-entry benefit over matched modular baseline.
hypotheses.next_test: GWT/Emergenz factorial with storage/activation stages independently controlled; no phenomenal-consciousness inference permitted

fusion2_transformation: The initial idea 'one unified database may make memory continuously available' was narrowed to 'one semantic/causal fabric with one authoritative operation commit scope and continuously maintained derived associative planes'; physical monolith is no longer the default hypothesis.
